speaker_title: Address by Mr. Paul Kagame, President of the Republic of Rwanda

paragraphs.text: • Excellency, Abdulla Shahid, President of the General Assembly
paragraphs.raw_text:
•	
Excellency, Abdulla Shahid, President of the General Assembly

paragraphs.text: • Excellency, Secretary-General António Guterres
paragraphs.raw_text:
•	
Excellency, Secretary-General António Guterres

paragraphs.text: • Excellencies, Heads of State and Government
paragraphs.raw_text:
•	
Excellencies, Heads of State and Government

paragraphs.text: • Distinguished Delegates
paragraphs.raw_text:
•	
Distinguished Delegates

paragraphs.text: Fighting the COVID-19 pandemic has challenged the international system like never before.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Fighting the COVID-19 pandemic has challenged the international system like 
never before.

paragraphs.text: However, alongside unfortunate examples of inequality, we have also seen evidence of the spirit of global solidarity and fairness, exemplifying the best values of our organisation.
paragraphs.raw_text:
However, alongside unfortunate examples of inequality, we have also seen 
evidence of the spirit of global solidarity and fairness, exemplifying the best values 
of our organisation.

paragraphs.text: The COVAX mechanism, despite its limitations, is one such case. Without this system, Africa’s vaccine deficit would be even more severe.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The COVAX mechanism, despite its limitations, is one such case. Without this 
system, Africa’s vaccine deficit would be even more severe.

paragraphs.text: But we can and must do more, to speed up vaccine distribution in Africa. Doing so benefits the entire world.
paragraphs.raw_text:
But we can and must do more, to speed up vaccine distribution in Africa. 
Doing so benefits the entire world.

paragraphs.text: The positive steps from various partners and companies toward building local vaccine manufacturing capacity is also very welcome.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The positive steps from various partners and companies toward building local 
vaccine manufacturing capacity is also very welcome.

paragraphs.text: We must harness this positive momentum to build long-term pandemic resilience, where it is needed most.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We must harness this positive momentum to build long-term pandemic 
resilience, where it is needed most.

paragraphs.text: The cooperation at the G-7 and G-20 to issue new Special Drawing Rights is another positive example.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The cooperation at the G-7 and G-20 to issue new Special Drawing Rights is 
another positive example.

paragraphs.text: A further voluntary reallocation of new SDRs to countries that need them most, will help create the fiscal space required for a faster and more equitable recovery from the pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
A further voluntary reallocation of new SDRs to countries that need them most, 
will help create the fiscal space required for a faster and more equitable recovery 
from the pandemic.

paragraphs.text: Nevertheless, the world is seriously off-track with the Sustainable Development Goals, as highlighted during today’s Food Systems Summit.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Nevertheless, the world is seriously off-track with the Sustainable Development 
Goals, as highlighted during today’s Food Systems Summit.

paragraphs.text: In fairness, we were behind schedule with the SDGs even before the pandemic hit. But there is now increased attention to figuring out how to refocus our efforts, and catch up.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In fairness, we were behind schedule with the SDGs even before the pandemic 
hit. But there is now increased attention to figuring out how to refocus our efforts, 
and catch up.

paragraphs.text: We need to convert this sense of urgency into a durable political commitment to achieving the SDGs.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We need to convert this sense of urgency into a durable political commitment 
to achieving the SDGs.

paragraphs.text: That commitment must put climate change mitigation at the centre of our efforts.
paragraphs.raw_text: That commitment must put climate change mitigation at the centre of our efforts.

paragraphs.text: The severity of weather-related disasters is increasing year-by-year.
paragraphs.raw_text: The severity of weather-related disasters is increasing year-by-year.

paragraphs.text: We cannot afford for the result of COP-26 in November to be inconclusive or divisive.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We cannot afford for the result of COP-26 in November to be inconclusive 
or divisive.

paragraphs.text: We also need to re-emphasize the importance of citizen-centred governance and accountability.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We also need to re-emphasize the importance of citizen-centred governance 
and accountability.

paragraphs.text: This not only guarantees well-being and material progress, but also security, stability, and confidence in the future.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This not only guarantees well-being and material progress, but also security, 
stability, and confidence in the future.

paragraphs.text: The extremist ideologies that drive terrorism and genocide must be named, identified early, and dismantled, without ambiguity or hesitation.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The extremist ideologies that drive terrorism and genocide must be named, 
identified early, and dismantled, without ambiguity or hesitation.

paragraphs.text: On that, we cannot afford to play politics.
paragraphs.raw_text: On that, we cannot afford to play politics.

paragraphs.text: I wish to conclude with a strong endorsement of the Secretary-General’s report on Our Common Agenda.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I wish to conclude with a strong endorsement of the Secretary-General’s report 
on Our Common Agenda.

paragraphs.text: The Secretary-General is right to warn of a possible breakdown in the multilateral system, in the face of the Covid pandemic, worsening conflict, the climate emergency, and chronic poverty.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Secretary-General is right to warn of a possible breakdown in the 
multilateral system, in the face of the Covid pandemic, worsening conflict, the 
climate emergency, and chronic poverty.

paragraphs.text: This would have disastrous consequences for all of us, and the risk should be taken seriously.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This would have disastrous consequences for all of us, and the risk should be 
taken seriously.

paragraphs.text: The Secretary-General’s Action Plan merits our full support, particularly the need for a global vaccination plan, a renewal of trust between governments and citizens, more focus on the needs of youth, and a rejuvenated commitment to factbased reasoning and science.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Secretary-General’s Action Plan merits our full support, particularly 
the need for a global vaccination plan, a renewal of trust between governments and 
citizens, more focus on the needs of youth, and a rejuvenated commitment to fact-
based reasoning and science.

paragraphs.text: Whether we are able to convene physically for the 77th General Assembly in 2022, or for the Secretary-General’s proposed Summit of the Future, depends on the actions we all take in the coming months.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Whether we are able to convene physically for the 77th General Assembly in 
2022, or for the Secretary-General’s proposed Summit of the Future, depends on the 
actions we all take in the coming months.

paragraphs.text: With determination and focus, it can be achieved.
paragraphs.raw_text: With determination and focus, it can be achieved.

paragraphs.text: Thank you for your kind attention.
paragraphs.raw_text: Thank you for your kind attention.
